subject: Tufts Bacon Hall Site Plan Review
overview: The Community Development Board approved a site plan for an academic addition at Tufts University under the Dover Amendment and conducted internal elections for board leadership.

items.title: Continuances for Verdant Bio, H Mart, and Bank of America
items.summary: The board continued public hearings for 243 Mystic Avenue and 285-295 Middlesex Avenue to August 2, 2023, and the hearing for 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway to August 16, 2023.

items.title: 550 Boston Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved a site plan for a 3,330-square-foot infill addition and utility upgrades at Tufts University's Bacon Hall for its new climate institute. The board discussed the project's compliance with the Dover Amendment and the applicant's agreement to install a new mid-block crosswalk on Boston Avenue.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from May 17, 2023.

items.title: Board Elections
items.summary: Elected Jackie McPherson as Chair and Emily Hedeman as Vice Chair. Decisions regarding the Clerk position and the Community Preservation Committee representative were tabled for a future meeting.

items.title: Staff Updates and Site Visit Procedures
items.summary: Staff announced the hiring of a new Climate Policy Planner and discussed a new internal tracking system to help board members conduct voluntary site visits ahead of public hearings.
